caption: The video showcases a top-down static view of a wooden floor where dominoes spell out "THE END" in white dominoes laid across a rainbow-colored standing base. A white domino trail loops around the right, bottom, and left of the text, while a separate straight trail lies at the upper left. Within the excerpt, a chain-reaction collapse is already underway and continues to spread. The white dominoes of "THE" tilt and fall first, the right side of their rainbow base begins to collapse, and then the right vertical segment of the surrounding loop topples. The bottom horizontal run then collapses right-to-left, followed by the left curved end dropping. Once the loop's left side falls, the "END" letters collapse from left to right, with the "E" tilting first, then the "N," and the "D" remaining only partially collapsed as the excerpt ends. The straight white trail at the upper left stays upright throughout, and the framing never shifts, so all visible motion comes from the falling dominoes.
